scope: All non-chair mesh objects in the full saved scene, including render-hidden geometry; exactly the rebuilt panel and left frame are scanned. Chair-local contacts were tested separately.
method_limitations: AABB separation and numerical surface intersection checks; containment uses at most 256 vertex samples in each direction and three agreed ray parities. No exact rational or exhaustive containment certificate. Minimum distance is a sampled vertex-to-surface upper bound.
